UserSyncProfile.title: User Sync Profile
UserSyncProfile.description: Owner-isolated synchronization anchor tracking the user's latest task sync heartbeat.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this sync profile.

displayName.description: Non-PII display label for the signed-in operator.

lastSyncAt.description: Server timestamp of the last successful sync cycle (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation timestamp (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedTask.title: Synced Task
SyncedTask.description: Cross-device JARVIS productivity task or smart reminder synchronized between Room and Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this task.

triggerAtMillis.description: Optional epoch milliseconds timestamp for scheduled local alarm notifications.

completed.description: Whether the task is marked complete.

deleted.description: Terminal soft-delete tombstone flag to propagate deletions across devices.

clientCreatedAtMillis.description: Immutable client epoch milliseconds when the task was created.

clientUpdatedAtMillis.description: Monotonic client epoch milliseconds used for last-write-wins multi-device conflict resolution.

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation timestamp (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-scoped sync metadata document for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing synchronized JARVIS tasks and tombstones keyed by stable syncId.
